$comment: Chunk totals are enforced by `pnpm verify check-budgets` after `pnpm build` (gzip -9 sums of every matched file). Route budgets are enforced by e2e/tests/budgets.spec.ts in Chromium: the gzip size of every script a page downloads until it's ready. A budget whose files don't exist yet must name the open issue that will create them. Rationale: ADR 0009.

budgets.name: web: all client JavaScript (backstop)
budgets.basis: Every chunk, including ones no page fetches until needed (13 of the 14 language grammars). 585 KB measured with the editor wired in (#27, Apple M4). A backstop against heavy additions; per-route budgets below say what users download. ADR 0009.

budgets.name: sync: server bundle
budgets.basis: esbuild bundle of the sync server (#47). Guards against accidentally bundling heavy dependencies.

routes.basis: 131.5 KB measured in Chromium (Apple M4) with the editor wired in: Next.js, React and the shell. The editor must never load here.
328.9 KB measured in Chromium (Apple M4): shell, editor, Yjs, y-indexeddb and the TypeScript grammar. 350 KB is the ADR 0004 editor basis.
